info.title: Comment service
info.description: Service that allows users to comment on topics.

get.description: Searches comments across the topics of the tenant, newest first. Core users must set tenantId. With `criteria.typeIdEquals`, requires read access to the topic type: its admin, commenter, or reader roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, or the export-service export-job role (`urn:ads:platform:export-service:export-job`) in the tenant; an unknown type responds 404. Without it, requires the comment-admin or export-job role in the tenant. Core roles don't grant access.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Defaults to 10. Must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor of the page to retrieve. Use the `page.next` value of the previous response to page sequentially through the results.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the comments to retrieve, as URL-encoded JSON. Must be valid JSON. The text criteria are PostgreSQL full text searches of a single word or phrase.

typeIdEquals.description: Only comments on topics of the topic type.

results.title: Follow up call
results.content: Called the applicant to confirm the mailing address.

get.description: Retrieves the topic types available to the tenant. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. The response separates the tenant's own types (`tenant`) from the platform types (`core`), each keyed by type ID. Topics can use either; a tenant type with the ID of a platform type replaces it. Core users that don't set tenantId receive only the platform types.

tenant.description: Topic types configured by the tenant, keyed by ID.

core.description: Platform topic types, keyed by ID.

post.description: Creates a topic type in the tenant's comment service configuration. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. The new type has no admin roles; set them with an update. The service responds 409 if the tenant or platform already has a type with the ID, or a type with a different ID has the same name.

readerRoles.description: Roles that can read topics of the type.

readRoles.description: Alternative name for readerRoles, used when readerRoles is not set.

writeRoles.description: Roles that can comment on topics of the type. Saved as the type's commenterRoles.

409.description: A topic type with the ID or name already exists.

get.description: Retrieves a topic type configured by the tenant. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. Only the tenant's own types are found; platform types respond 404, so use the topic types list to read them.

patch.description: Updates a topic type configured by the tenant. Properties not in the request keep their values. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. Platform types respond 404.

adminRoles.description: Roles that can administer topics of the type.

readerRoles.description: Roles that can read topics of the type.

commenterRoles.description: Roles that can comment on topics of the type.

securityClassification.description: Security classification for new topics of the type.

delete.description: Deletes a topic type configured by the tenant. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. The service responds 409 while any topic of the type exists; delete those topics first. Platform types respond 404.

409.description: Topics of the type exist and must be deleted first.

topics.description: Number of topics of the type.

example.errorMessage: Topic type 'case-notes' cannot be deleted because 3 topic(s) are associated with it.

get.description: Retrieves topics of the tenant, in order of ID. Available to any authenticated user, but results only include the topics the user can read: users with the type's admin, commenter, or reader roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, users listed in the topic's commenters, and users with the comment-admin or topic-setter role in the tenant or as a core role. Users with the export-service export-job role (`urn:ads:platform:export-service:export-job`) receive all matching topics. A page can therefore hold fewer than `top` results while `page.next` is set. Core users must set tenantId.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the topics to retrieve, as URL-encoded JSON. Must be valid JSON.

resourceIdEquals.description: ID or URN of the entity the topics are about.

requiresAttention.description: When true, only topics that require attention. False is the same as not setting it.

post.description: Creates a topic in the tenant. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. The topic type can be one of the tenant's types or a platform type. The topic's security classification is taken from its type.

typeId.description: ID of the topic type of the topic.

commenters.description: IDs of additional users who can read and comment on the topic.

resourceId.description: ID or URN of the entity the topic is about.

get.description: Retrieves a topic of the tenant. Requires read access to the topic: the topic type's admin, commenter, or reader roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, being listed in the topic's commenters, or the comment-admin or topic-setter role in the tenant or as a core role. The directory service resource-resolver role (`urn:ads:platform:directory-service:resource-resolver`) can also retrieve it. Core users must set tenantId. Topics of another tenant respond 404.

patch.description: Updates a topic of the tenant. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. Topics of another tenant respond 404.

commenters.description: IDs of additional users who can read and comment on the topic. Replaces the existing list.

delete.description: Deletes a topic of the tenant and its comments. Requires the comment-admin or topic-setter role, held in the tenant or as a core (platform) role. Core users must set tenantId. Topics of another tenant respond 404.

get.description: Retrieves comments of a topic, newest first. Requires read access to the topic: the topic type's admin, commenter, or reader roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, being listed in the topic's commenters, or the comment-admin or topic-setter role in the tenant or as a core role. Core users must set tenantId. Topics of another tenant respond 404.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the comments to retrieve, as URL-encoded JSON. Must be valid JSON. The text criteria are PostgreSQL full text searches of a single word or phrase.

idGreaterThan.description: Only comments with a greater ID, for example to get comments posted since the last read.

results.title: Follow up call
results.content: Called the applicant to confirm the mailing address.

post.description: Posts a comment on a topic. Requires comment access to the topic: the topic type's admin or commenter roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, or being listed in the topic's commenters. Core users must set tenantId. Topics of another tenant respond 404.

context.description: Arbitrary JSON context data associated with the comment.

requiresAttention.description: Sets (true) or clears (false) the topic's requiresAttention flag.

example.title: Follow up call
example.content: Called the applicant to confirm the mailing address.

get.description: Retrieves a comment of a topic. Requires read access to the topic: the topic type's admin, commenter, or reader roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, being listed in the topic's commenters, or the comment-admin or topic-setter role in the tenant or as a core role. Core users must set tenantId. Topics and comments of another tenant respond 404.

patch.description: Updates a comment of a topic. Requires the topic type's admin roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, or comment access to the topic for the author of the comment. Core users must set tenantId. Topics and comments of another tenant respond 404.

title.description: Title of the comment. A null value keeps the existing title.

context.description: Arbitrary JSON context data. When supplied, it replaces the existing context.

example.content: Called the applicant to confirm the mailing and residential addresses.

delete.description: Deletes a comment of a topic. Requires the topic type's admin roles (or comment-admin) in the tenant, or comment access to the topic for the author of the comment. Core users must set tenantId. Topics and comments of another tenant respond 404.

CommentAfter.name: after
CommentAfter.description: Cursor of the page to retrieve. Use the `page.next` value of the previous response to page sequentially through the results.

CommentTenantId.name: tenantId
CommentTenantId.description: ID of the tenant to act on. Only used for core (platform) users and service accounts; tenant users always act on the tenant of their token and this parameter is ignored. Core users must set it, since topic types, topics, and comments all belong to a tenant. A value that is not a tenant URN responds 400.

CommentTop.name: top
CommentTop.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

CommentBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a path, query, or body parameter failed validation, the request body is not valid JSON, or the tenantId query parameter is not a tenant URN.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): topicId (params) - Invalid value

CommentForbidden.description: User does not have a role required for the operation.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 7d3c2a1b-4e5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d) not permitted to post comment.

CommentNotFound.description: Topic type, topic, or comment not found in the tenant.

example.errorMessage: topic with ID '42' could not be found.

CommentUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token.

context.description: Arbitrary JSON context data associated with the comment.

example.title: Follow up call
example.content: Called the applicant to confirm the mailing address.

CommentResultsPage.description: Paging information of a result set.

after.description: Cursor of the page that was returned.

next.description: Cursor of the next page. Not set when there are no more results.

name.description: Name of the user. Null when the comment is returned to a topic commenter who is not its author.

urn.description: URN of the topic, for example for use as the resource ID of other ADSP resources.

resourceId.description: ID or URN of the entity the topic is about.

commenters.description: IDs of additional users who can read and comment on the topic, for example the person a case is about. Names of other users are removed from comments returned to these users.

securityClassification.description: Security classification of the topic, set from its topic type when the topic is created.

requiresAttention.description: Set or cleared by the requiresAttention flag of a new comment.

TopicType.description: Topic type, which sets the roles permitted to administer, comment on, and read topics of the type. Roles are held in the topic's tenant; the comment-admin role always grants administrator access.

adminRoles.description: Roles that can read and comment on topics of the type, and update or delete any comment on them.

readerRoles.description: Roles that can read topics of the type and their comments.

commenterRoles.description: Roles that can read topics of the type, post comments, and update or delete their own comments.
